title: lint: the object_extension publish door runs no field-formula judgment, so a computed field os build refuses still publishes through PUT /meta/object_extension
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvfX5bawZKtfa6u7j9

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up a dev report surfaced (#32875, os-dev-report 6847088184, class a, measured at PR #33070 head `7b18b05f`). Not reproduced over HTTP by the dev or the filer.
Reader: the lane that owns the runtime authoring-rule roster (`runtimeTypes` of `validateStackExpressions` in `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, read by `runtimeAuthoringRulesFor`).

## 维护者速读

PR #33070（#32875）之后，`os build` / `os validate` 会检查对象扩展加的存储型计算字段的公式；但运行时保存对象扩展（`PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/TARGET`，Studio 在 `.custom` 对上加字段）只跑 `validateSecurityRoleWord`，不跑公式检查。于是 build 会拒的计算字段，经运行时保存仍能发布。两道门对同一个字段判法不一致。

## What happens

- `runtimeAuthoringRulesFor('object_extension')` answers only `['validateSecurityRoleWord']`: `validateStackExpressions` declares `runtimeTypes` flow / action / hook / object / view / page, not `object_extension`.
- So an `object_extension` write runs no field-formula judgment and publishes a computed field that `os build` refuses after PR #33070.

## Expected

The `object_extension` publish door asks the same field-formula judgment the build asks of an extension field (against the extended object as served), so the two doors agree; a refusal at the door carries the same rule id and location the build prints.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open object_extension validateSecurityRoleWord` → #32875 only (the build half). Related: #32875, PR #33070, #32529.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading and lane are triage's.
